title: GWP-ASan、Scudo 与 MTE：低开销检测和运行时防护
key_conclusions: GWP-ASan, Scudo, and MTE are lower-overhead or production-adjacent defenses, not replacements for precise ASan/HWASan debugging.
GWP-ASan provides sparse but strong evidence when sampled allocations hit UAF or OOB bugs.
Scudo hardens allocator metadata and detects invalid free, double free, and metadata corruption, but may not identify the first corrupting write.
MTE uses hardware memory tagging to expand UAF/OOB coverage on supported devices and system policies.
shallow_points: The article does not include real GWP-ASan crash reports, Scudo abort messages, or MTE tag fault artifacts.
It does not validate concrete Android properties, manifest options, system settings, or platform defaults across Android versions and ROMs.
It does not quantify overhead, sampling rate, crash yield, or false-negative behavior on target devices.
It does not include a rollout policy for debug, dogfood, beta, production-adjacent, and platform builds.

Day 37's ASan precise report workflow remains the fallback for reproducing bugs found by GWP-ASan, Scudo, or MTE.
